data.gender_notes: Neala is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word neos, meaning new, and the Latin word ala, meaning wing. Neala is a name of grace and light, symbolizing new beginnings and renewal. The name Neala carries the meaning “Light, Grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Neala usually hope their child will grow to embody light, grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name full of light and hope, inspiring the bearer to soar and overcome.
data.etymology: Neala belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Neala total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'נעל' (na'al), which means 'to be graceful', 'to be gracious', 'to be pleasing', 'to favor', 'to be kind'. The name Neala is derived from this root and means 'grace', 'favor', or 'pleasing'.

in_greek.name: Νεαλά
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'νέος' (neos), which means 'new', 'fresh', or 'young'. The name Neala is derived from this root and may mean 'new', 'fresh', or 'young'.

in_english.name: Neala
in_english.long_meaning: From the English word 'Neala', which is derived from the Hebrew name 'נְעָלָה' (Ne'ala), which means 'grace', 'favor', or 'pleasing'.

data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, Neala represents the idea of rebirth and renewal, as well as the power of wings, symbolizing the ability to soar above challenges and rise above the ordinary. This name is a reminder that no matter what life throws at us, we always have the power to start anew and reach for greater heights. Neala is a beautiful name that inspires hope, courage, and the strength to overcome obstacles.
